method: All-glyph, per-size natural/quantized fitting against source-balanced outlines; protect the resolvable counters and ink cores of an uncompensated original-source resize at the same new axes and dimensions. Historical 1.400 ink is a separate comparison. Score local ink distortion, contrast and phase variation. Strong fitting is reserved for detail preservation. Direct glyph fallback requires full-range source-detail and bounds validation. No character-name selection rules.
geometryReference: Direct quadratic/cubic paths rasterized at 256 px/em, normalized to the ink bounding box. Multiscale 8×8/4×4 ink mass and axis projections plus a density term; mean and worst horizontal phases. These are shape-fidelity proxies, not readability scores.

boundsSafety.method: Test every hinted glyph at all fitted sizes/phases against its outline bounds. Allow 2 px plus PPEM/16. Programs exceeding this budget, or whose fitting modes lose resolvable source details, can be bypassed only after direct rendering passes bounds, visibility and detail checks across the entire range. Detail reference: uncompensated original-source resize at the same new design axes and dimensions. No character-name selection rules.
